reason: My team already lives in Excel and Telegram and it works well enough. I would maybe try the free 14 days, but I would not pay in the first month because getting 10+ salespeople to change how they report is the real work, not the price.
objection: Free migration is nice, but my people will still have to relearn everything and they hate new tools. There are no customer references, so if it fails I look bad to the director.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a similar-sized Uzbek company that moved from Excel and Telegram and kept using it, plus a demo where my own spreadsheet is imported in one day and sales reports build themselves.
